WITH mix_counts AS (
  SELECT
    t.ordertypedist,
    COUNT(DISTINCT t.transreg) AS transaction_count
  FROM advancedbehavior AS a
  JOIN transactionrecord AS t
    ON a.translink = t.transreg
  GROUP BY t.ordertypedist
),
mix_shares AS (
  SELECT
    ordertypedist,
    transaction_count,
    transaction_count::numeric / SUM(transaction_count) OVER () AS share
  FROM mix_counts
),
scored AS (
  SELECT
    ordertypedist,
    transaction_count,
    share,
    AVG(share) OVER () AS baseline_average_share
  FROM mix_shares
)
SELECT
  COALESCE(ordertypedist, 'No mix recorded') AS order_type_mix,
  transaction_count,
  share,
  share - baseline_average_share AS above_baseline
FROM scored
WHERE share > baseline_average_share;
